summary: Camtek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on July 29, 2026. The proxy statement was previously furnished on June 24, 2026. Shareholders approved all proposals presented. The filing is a routine current report on shareholder meeting outcomes and does not involve any special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other extraordinary transaction. There are no deal terms because it is a standard governance update.
